'''October 2000 Houlton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Houlton, Maine on 28 October 2000. [[Cullen Burns]] won it. It is known from Jayke Ball's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1406">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-houlton-maine-10-28-00d1406/ houlton-maine-10-28-00], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 30 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-30-houlton-maine-10-28-00d1406/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Houlton, Maine
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Cullen Burns]]
